name: Newegg (US online retailer, GPU category)
price_basis: ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 3090 24GB GDDR6X bare card, Newegg direct, pre-tax, observed 2026-10-03. Same-day peer listings: GIGABYTE Gaming OC $2,399.00, MSI Suprim X $2,399.00, EVGA FTW3 Ultra $2,399.00, ASUS ROG Strix OC $2,499.00, NVIDIA FE $2,180.00.
notes: In practice a marketplace as much as a retailer: the RTX 3090 listing page was topped by third-party MXZ PC gaming desktops, and one RTX 3090 FE listing was sold by a non-Newegg seller with a 4-business-day ship window. The RTX 3090 is no longer a value pick in new condition here - a 2020 flagship lists at roughly 1.5x a current RTX 5070 Ti ($1,249.99 at B&H on the same date). Arc B580 boards were visible at $355.15, above the $309.99 Micro Center price. Filter to 'Sold by Newegg' + 'In Stock' or you are buying grey-market import cards with no US warranty.
